name: Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol)

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: The animal form of vitamin D, hydroxylated in liver and kidney to the active hormone calcitriol. Sold as a dietary supplement; high-dose prescription ergocalciferol is separately available.

systems.note: Calcium and bone homeostasis and broader endocrine signalling; the intended effect.
Hypercalcaemia and nephrocalcinosis at sustained excessive intake.

monitors.why: The storage form and the direct index of intake and status.
Hypercalcaemia is the toxicity of excess.
